name: Timeo
source: Timeo is an Omega Werewolf of the Crimson Pack. He is a kind-natured person, however, he's scared very easily. After being raised hearing stories about King Lucius and Prince Atlas, he admires them deeply. But he cares for nobody more than his older sister, [url=/c140929]Gina[/url]. She has cared for him from a very young age after the death of their parents and he would do anything to keep her safe.
